mapper.sql: u.id, u.tenant_id, u.login_name, u.password_hash, u.display_name, u.display_name_kana, u.locale, u.email, u.phone, u.user_status, u.locked_flag, t.tenant_code, t.tenant_status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ua_user u LEFT JOIN ua_tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.login_name = #{loginName}

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM ua_user_role ur INNER JOIN ua_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN ua_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.enabled_flag = 1
SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_code FROM ua_user_role ur INNER JOIN ua_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN ua_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.enabled_flag = 1

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(rds.module_code, ':', rds.scope_type, ':', COALESCE(rds.scope_value, '')) FROM ua_user_role ur INNER JOIN ua_role_data_scope rds ON rds.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
